b.label: Citizens Against UFO Secrecy v. National Security Agency (Civil Action No. 80-1562)

edges.label: CAUS was the plaintiff in Civil Action No. 80-1562
edges.note: The organisation brought the case that produced judicial confirmation that NSA holds UFO-related records it will not release.

edges.label: Yeates executed the affidavit as NSA Chief of Policy
edges.note: The affidavit was submitted for in camera review only; the plaintiffs never saw it and the judge ruled for NSA on its basis.

edges.label: 2013 Mandatory Declassification Review forced further release of the NSA UFO holdings
edges.note: NSA had released the COMINT records with most pages carrying only a few visible words, redacted in white-out; an MDR was required to obtain more.

edges.label: Gersten directed CAUS and brought its FOIA litigation
edges.note: Gersten's litigation against CIA, NSA and DoD is the origin of the document-first method in this field.

b.label: Citizens Against UFO Secrecy v. National Security Agency (Civil Action No. 80-1562)

edges.label: The affidavit is the instrument by which withholding was sustained
edges.note: The United States has never asserted that the records do not exist. Its sworn position is that they cannot be disclosed.
